main.description: Find places in a dataset whose name matches a keyword's words, most notable first. Takes no point and ranks by no distance; a region, if given, is whole degrees.

collection.description: Narrow results to records of this collection of the dataset

q.description: The keyword. A place matches when each word of the keyword begins a word of one of the place's names, ignoring case and accents; apostrophes are dropped and other punctuation splits words. Only the first 12 distinct words are used; at least one of them must be two or more characters long

bbox.description: Optional region, west,south,east,north in whole degrees; west > 0 > east crosses the antimeridian, if the box has width. A place matches when its point lies in the region, or, with no point, its bounding box meets it

places.description: At most 20 matches, importance descending, then record key ascending

errors.name: KeywordRequired
errors.description: Among q's first 12 distinct words, once case, accents and punctuation are removed, none is two or more characters long

errors.name: BboxTooPrecise
errors.description: A bbox coordinate is not a whole number of degrees

errors.name: InvalidBbox
errors.description: The bbox parameter must be four comma-separated numbers with south < north and west < east, except that a box crossing the antimeridian has west > 0 > east and is not 180 to -180

errors.name: DatasetNotFound
errors.description: This server serves no tileset carrying the dataset

errors.name: CollectionNotFound
errors.description: This server serves the dataset but no tileset carrying the collection
